title: Classify patent claims as product or process — fn.patccat
text: data data frame claim lines: one row per claim line. varPatentClaim Column naming claim key (default "PatentClaim"). varText Column claim text (default "text"). varLevel Column line level (default "level"). varSequence Column line sequence (default "sequence"). varID Column unique row id (default "id"). extractPreambleTerms Extract preamble terms (default TRUE). extractPreambleText Extract preamble text; required Beauregard detection (default TRUE). timeOutput Print timing (default TRUE). integrityCheck Run input integrity check (default TRUE). params, claim.rules, process.words, product.words, processwords.simple Optional overrides classifier's internal parameters word lists. defaults NULL, meaning validated internal value used, default call reproduces classifier exactly. Supplying values changes classification leaves validated AMT baseline behind; intended research experimentation. See patccat_defaults inspect internal values (available), package data.

title: Classify patent claims as product or process — fn.patccat
text: data frame one row per independent claim, keyed PatentClaim. label claimType (0 = uncategorized, 1 = process/method, 2 = product); product--process folded product flagged prodByProcess. Alongside claim-structure flags, including independent, singleLine, Jepson, isMeans (means-plus-function), markush, beauregard, nonTransitory, computerImplemented, stepPlusFunction, plus structural fields preambleType, bodyType, transitionType, word counts wordsPreamble wordsBody.

patccatClaims 0.1.0
text: Initial release – core patccat product/process claim classifier standalone, installable package. fn.patccat() (alias patccat_classify()) classify U.S. patent claims product process return claim-structure flags (means-plus-function, Jepson, Beauregard, Markush, single-line, others). patccat_load_model() downloads caches pinned udpipe English-EWT model (ud-2.5-191206) first use; model shipped package. patccat_defaults() exposes validated internal parameters word lists, seeds opt-override arguments fn.patccat(). fn.benchmarking() scores classifier output gold benchmark. Reproduces committed AMT validation baseline exactly: accuracy 0.9972248, coverage 0.9897253 9,830-claim multi-line sample. R CMD check clean.
